summary: Live site https://eletricaldas.com.br/ tested with Playwright (mobile 390x844, wa.me blocked, tel: prevented), plus a review of the GTM container JSON and the Apps Script node test. Every requested check passed: only gtm.js?id=GTM-W2FM3MNH loads; no G-34GW7YSWYZ or GTM-N8PP79HM requests; GA4 hits before consent go with gcs=G100 and after 'Aceitar' with gcs=G111. WhatsApp click: dataLayer generate_lead lead_method=whatsapp, GA4 hit en=generate_lead tid=G-EMKHDNXVN1, Ads conversion label=1o2gCIWM94UbENPj1aE_ value=1 currency_code=BRL. Ligue Agora click: generate_lead lead_method=telefone plus Ads conversion label=M_BMCMq79oUbENPj1aE_. Scrolling sends scroll_profundidade with epn.percent_scrolled 25/50/75/90. After 30s, tempo_na_pagina is sent with epn.tempo_segundos=30. Ads conversion hits include em=tv.1&ec_mode=a, so enhanced conversions are active in automatic mode on the web tag. The container JSON is valid (exportFormatVersion 2, publicId GTM-W2FM3MNH, 8 tags, 5 triggers); all firingTriggerIds exist or are built-in; every variable used exists (only {{_event}} is GTM-internal, which is standard). node tests/test_code_gs.js: 8/8 PASS.
action_items: Optional: Code.gs hardcodes 'Ad User Data'/'Ad Personalization' = 'Granted' in the Google Ads tab. This is acceptable because sendLeadToSheet only runs when getAdClick() returns a value, which requires consent granted. Document this or keep it.
Optional: GA4 Enhanced Measurement 'scroll' still fires (one en=scroll hit seen) alongside scroll_profundidade. The user should turn off 'Rolagens' in the GA4 data stream, as LEIA-ME already says.

Optional: onEdit does not clear 'Data/Hora do fechamento' if 'sim' is removed, and it only handles single-cell edits (paste over multiple rows ignores the others). toE164 returns '' for numbers typed with an operator code (e.g. '0 15 64 9...').
critical_code_review_comments: index.html: the second inline gtag('js', new Date()) after gtm.js is redundant with GTM (harmless).
Code.gs doPost: JSON.parse is not wrapped in try/catch, so a malformed body throws instead of returning 'ignored' (minor).

The GTM container has no user-provided-data configuration. Enhanced conversions show as active through the Ads account automatic mode (ec_mode=a), and enhanced conversions for leads go through the Sheets import. Fine for a site without forms.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static site, no backend. Live checks done via Playwright request capture. GA4 batches events in the POST body of /g/collect; parse post_data. Navigate to about:blank to flush batched hits. The Google Ads Data Manager import cannot be tested without the user's account.
